title: Family flat
goal: A reader must be able to identify a complete three-bedroom family flat and follow the hall to every room.

rubric.must: Three separately labeled bedrooms are visible, each with its own door onto the central hall.
Living Room and Dining Room are visibly separate labeled spaces.
Two separately labeled bathrooms with sanitary fixtures are visible.
The kitchen visibly contains a counter, sink, stove, and refrigerator.
The central hall provides an unobstructed route from the entry to every bedroom and bathroom.
Door swing arcs and exterior windows are clearly visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules, while the picture combines the living and dining spaces and lacks a clearly identifiable kitchen sink.
